findings_summary: Resolved hardcoded run_cycle failure via exact wavefront drain mathematics (61 + PE_LATENCY + 1). Pipelined C48 collection MUX aligned with synchronous BRAM read, eliminating 12288:192 combinational mux delay from adder. Validated bit-exact results across latencies 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, real array integration (array16_direct_v020 vs array16_w7_c48_cfg) across 4 quadrants and cross-K (K=64), double-buffering (SLOTS=2), and skid-buffer backpressure with zero data loss.
